The comparison now contains 100 Full/minus_A pairs (200 records), covering IID and non-IID data under all five scenarios with ten matched model seeds per scene. Every metric uses the same fixed round-70 checkpoint and the same 19,867 validation images. The previous five-seed Sp-DFA exclusion describes the historical A90 cutoff; the ten-seed A100 scene is now included.

**Added non-IID Sp-DFA paired evidence.** The following values are the saved same-seed differences, minus_A−Full, in ΔACC / ΔAEOD / ΔASPD order, reported as means ± sample SD (ddof=1). ΔACC is measured in percentage points; the disparity differences are absolute gaps. For native, 10 seeds: -0.158 ± 1.560 / +0.00492 ± 0.01996 / -0.00131 ± 0.02604; 9 seeds: -0.295 ± 1.589 / +0.00597 ± 0.02088 / -0.00420 ± 0.02587; 6 seeds: +0.115 ± 1.320 / -0.00037 ± 0.00996 / +0.00187 ± 0.02258. For raw, 10 seeds: -0.238 ± 1.567 / +0.00423 ± 0.01094 / +0.00306 ± 0.00791; 9 seeds: -0.362 ± 1.609 / +0.00257 ± 0.01018 / +0.00116 ± 0.00546; 6 seeds: -0.014 ± 1.302 / -0.00036 ± 0.00953 / -0.00018 ± 0.00530. For shared calibration, 10 seeds: -0.158 ± 1.560 / +0.00492 ± 0.01996 / -0.00131 ± 0.02604; 9 seeds: -0.295 ± 1.589 / +0.00597 ± 0.02088 / -0.00420 ± 0.02587; 6 seeds: +0.115 ± 1.320 / -0.00037 ± 0.00996 / +0.00187 ± 0.02258. These values come directly from the paired rows of the [adopted JSON](E:/OneDrive/文档/GuardFed/docs/server_deployment_20260923/training_20260923/celeba_mechanism_v1/three_view_A_ten_scenes100_20261011/tables.json), not from separately selected seeds or checkpoints. Native deletion yields lower mean ACC, higher mean AEOD, lower mean ASPD. Raw deletion yields lower mean ACC, higher mean AEOD, higher mean ASPD. Shared-calibration deletion yields lower mean ACC, higher mean AEOD, lower mean ASPD. Lower ACC is unfavorable and lower disparity is favorable. These are panel-mean directions, not a claim about every seed or statistical significance; the fixed 10/9/6 panels remain visible together.

**Fixed-panel direction changes.** In the ten- and nine-seed native/shared panels, retaining A has higher mean ACC and lower mean AEOD, whereas deleting A has lower mean ASPD. All three directions reverse in the six-seed native/shared panel: deleting A has higher mean ACC and lower mean AEOD, but retaining A has lower mean ASPD. Under raw prediction, the ten- and nine-seed means favor retaining A on all three metrics. The six-seed raw panel instead trades lower mean accuracy after deletion for lower means of both disparity gaps. These reversals follow the predefined subsets and prediction rules; we report them together rather than choosing a favorable panel. They do not establish an effect for every seed or statistical significance.

**Seed-first cross-scene evidence.** The [additional saved aggregates](E:/OneDrive/文档/GuardFed/docs/server_deployment_20260923/training_20260923/celeba_mechanism_v1/three_view_A_ten_scenes100_20261011/CROSS_SCENE_ADDITIONAL.json) now report both the five-non-IID and balanced-ten-scene summaries; the [five-IID summary](E:/OneDrive/文档/GuardFed/docs/server_deployment_20260923/training_20260923/celeba_mechanism_v1/three_view_A_ten_scenes100_20261011/IID_SEED_FIRST.json) is retained unchanged. Within each seed, scenes receive equal weight before the across-seed mean and sample SD are computed. A favorable average does not imply a gain in every scene or seed, and aggregation does not erase adverse or mixed scene-specific results.

**Interpretation and remaining scope.** A100 completes this A-deletion comparison, not all image mechanisms. Native/shared equality in the saved records is not independent confirmation. AEOD retains the project absolute-TPR-gap definition, not full equalized odds. The nine-seed panel excludes configuration-selection seed 91001 and the six-seed panel uses 91005–91010 for both variants.

**A100 provenance and manuscript boundary.** Actual replay-device counts are {"Full": {"cpu": 5, "cuda:0": 95}, "minus_A": {"cpu": 100}}; training-build counts are {"Full": {"2.11.0+cu128": 98, "2.11.0+cu130": 2}, "minus_A": {"2.11.0+cu128": 100}}. Mixed CPU/CUDA, cu128/cu130 and driver histories remain disclosed; no runtime or trajectory equivalence is asserted. Root-only calibration, exposed validation selection and previously inspected official-test results remain explicit: this is not untouched confirmation. U100/C100 and all historical A80/A90 evidence remain unchanged. The other five image-control variants and seven remaining baseline coverages still require completion; Huber's identity-projection CNN adaptation does not inherit its original theorem, and LoGoFair's virtual cohorts are not real-client fairness evidence. P1 and P3–P6, the final primary endpoint, frozen final evaluation and submitted-manuscript integration remain pending. These are author-review insertion candidates, not applied manuscript changes or final-test findings; no universal-win, significance or all-component-necessity claim is made.
